title: 第一卷 第11章 收尾第一卷 第12章 大获
content_zh:
提着兔皮和形似小鹿的小兽皮毛，连带着一百文铜钱上集市，李乘风全程无比自然，与寻常无异。
两张兔皮加一张小鹿皮确实卖不上什么钱，出手后也就卖了一百三十文。
李乘风又拿着这一百三十文，连带着自己带来的一百文，去买了一把新菜刀，一把柴刀，二十颗铁箭头，一共还剩下三十文钱。
又拿着买了五斤青菜，剩下二十五文，他又去打听了一下铁锅的价格，发现想要买一口铁锅最少也要两百文，也就叹着气提着这些东西回去了。
什么事也没发生，一路平静的回到家里，李乘风敲了敲门，刘玉娘满脸担忧的开门把他放进了屋里。
“阿生，没事吧？”
见李乘风买回来的这么多东西，刘玉娘赶紧帮忙把东西摘下来，随后面色忐忑的对着李乘风关切的询问。
“没事，能有啥事。”
李乘风听到她的话轻笑着摇了摇头，故作轻松的张开怀抱抱了抱她，随后拍着她的肩膀宽慰，“我再去进山一趟看看能不能捕到点东西，你在家等着我，谁来也别开门。”
李乘风面色轻松的开口，“刘宏那厮家里拿回来的东西得处理掉，正好昨天在山上认识了些猎人，把东西带山里看看能不能碰到他们。”
“要是碰到了，就问问他们要不要这些玩意，把这些东西交给他们，换些东西来。”
刘宏的东西留在家里是个麻烦，虽然收回来的东西李乘风也有需要，但是安全起见，除了粮食别的东西还是要出掉的好。
再借用这些出掉的钱，买新的，这样他也就能无顾虑的拥有这些东西来。
“我听你的，只是万事要小心。”
听到他的话，刘玉娘迟疑的点了点头，目光担忧的看着他开口。
“行，不过等会玉娘还得帮我点忙才行。”
李乘风看着刘玉娘的样子，笑着点了点头，随后指着屋外的竹林开口，眼神闪烁，“这次进山，我要下几个陷阱，看看能不能捉点东西，等会在家里砍好竹子装在麻袋里。”
“好，我帮你一起装竹子。”
听到李乘风这么说，刘玉娘立即反应过来他是什么意思，急忙点了点脑袋，满口答应。
见她回答的干脆，李乘风脸上也露出了笑容，他紧跟着就打开门，和刘玉娘一起到院子里。

两人到了院子里，李乘风拿着柴刀走到竹林边，瞅中一棵竹子，手中柴刀一扬。
“欻~”
一声轻响，竹子立即倒地，后面跟着的刘玉娘当即将竹子捡起来用手里的破菜刀砍掉乱细枝，一分为二，撞在一边的麻袋里。
“欻欻欻~”
李乘风挥舞柴刀，不断砍伐，逮到合适的竹子就砍下来，后面的刘玉娘则捡着竹子去除乱枝。
不多时，竹竿砍的差不多了，李乘风也来帮忙去除乱枝，随后将去掉的乱枝连竹竿一起塞到麻袋里。
趁着没人看见，顺势和刘玉娘一起把那口铁锅和钢刀、柴刀一一塞到竹子中间，上面那再铺上竹枝，夹杂着长短不一的竹竿。
不多时，一袋子竹枝加竹竿就塞满了麻袋，看上去毫无异样。
刘玉娘抿着嘴开始细致地整理，李乘风则去把箭头拿了出来。
找到院子里那些足够坚韧的老细竹竿装进去做箭矢，他这次精心制作，除了箭头外，箭尾也装上了野鸡羽毛，以增加箭矢稳定性。
等到制作完了二十根带羽铁箭头竹箭，时间也差不多了。
李乘风当即把弓箭柴刀拿着，背着麻袋，箭矢和柴刀一起挂在腰上，提着两个水葫芦，拿着刘玉娘早上给他煮好的兽血加掺了菜的饭团，和刘玉娘挥了挥手，在她抿着嘴的注视之中离开了家里。
content_en:
Li Chengfeng carried rabbit skins and small deer-like animal skins to the market, along with a hundred copper coins. The whole process was very natural and no different for Li Chengfeng.
Two rabbit skins and one deer skin really didn't cost much, so they only sold for 130 cash.
Li Chengfeng took the one hundred and thirty coins, together with the hundred coins he brought, to buy a new kitchen knife, a hatchet, and twenty iron arrowheads, leaving a total of thirty coins left.
He bought another five kilograms of vegetables, leaving twenty-five cents. He went to inquire about the price of the iron pot, and found that it would cost at least two hundred cents to buy an iron pot, so he sighed and went back with these things.
Nothing happened, and he returned home peacefully. Li Chengfeng knocked on the door, and Liu Yuniang opened the door with a worried look on her face and let him in.
"A Sheng, are you okay?"
Seeing that Li Chengfeng had bought so many things, Liu Yuniang hurriedly helped to pick them off, and then asked Li Chengfeng with concern with an uneasy expression.
"It's okay, what can happen?"
Li Chengfeng chuckled and shook his head after hearing her words. He opened his arms and hugged her pretending to be relaxed, then patted her shoulder to comfort her, "I'll go into the mountains again to see if I can catch something. You wait for me at home, and don't open the door to anyone."
Li Chengfeng said with a relaxed expression, "We need to get rid of the things that Liu Hong brought back from his house. I happened to meet some hunters in the mountains yesterday, so I took my things into the mountains to see if I can encounter them."
"If you come across it, just ask them if they want these things, give them to them, and exchange them for something else."
It was troublesome to leave Liu Hong's things at home. Although Li Chengfeng also needed the recovered things, for safety reasons, it was better to get rid of other things besides food.
Then borrow the money to buy new ones, so that he can own these things without any worries.
"I listen to you, just be careful in everything."
Hearing his words, Liu Yuniang nodded hesitantly and looked at him with worried eyes.
"Okay, but Lady Yu will have to help me a little later."
Li Chengfeng looked at Liu Yuniang's appearance, smiled and nodded, then pointed to the bamboo forest outside the house and said with twinkling eyes, "This time when I go into the mountains, I will set a few traps to see if I can catch anything. I will chop the bamboo at home and put it in a sack."
"Okay, I'll help you load the bamboo together."
Hearing what Li Chengfeng said, Liu Yuniang immediately realized what he meant, nodded her head hurriedly, and agreed.
Seeing her crisp answer, Li Chengfeng also had a smile on his face. He immediately opened the door and went to the yard with Liu Yuniang.
The two of them arrived in the yard. Li Chengfeng walked to the bamboo forest with a hatchet. He spotted a bamboo and raised the hatchet in his hand.
"欻~"
With a soft sound, the bamboo immediately fell to the ground. Liu Yuniang, who was following behind, immediately picked up the bamboo and chopped off the twigs with the broken kitchen knife in her hand, split it in two, and bumped it into the sack on the side.
"嬻欻欻~"
Li Chengfeng wielded a hatchet and kept cutting down suitable bamboos. Liu Yuniang behind him picked up bamboos and removed random branches.
After a while, the bamboo pole was almost chopped, and Li Chengfeng came to help remove the random branches, and then stuffed the removed random branches into the sack together with the bamboo pole.
While no one was watching, Liu Yuniang and Liu Yuniang took advantage of the situation and stuffed the iron pot, steel knife, and hatchet into the middle of the bamboo one by one, and then spread bamboo branches on top, mixed with bamboo poles of different lengths.
Not long after, a bag of bamboo branches and bamboo poles was filled with sacks, which looked nothing out of the ordinary.
Liu Yuniang pursed her lips and began to sort it out carefully, while Li Chengfeng went to take out the arrow.
He found those old and thin bamboo poles in the yard that were tough enough and put them into arrows. This time he made them carefully. In addition to the arrowheads, the tails of the arrows were also equipped with pheasant feathers to increase the stability of the arrows.
By the time I finished making twenty bamboo arrows with feathered iron arrowheads, it was almost time.
Li Chengfeng shouldThat is to say, he held the bow, arrow and hatchet, a sack on his back, the arrows and hatchet were hung on his waist, he carried two water hyacinths, and the rice balls mixed with animal blood and vegetables that Liu Yuniang had cooked for him in the morning. He waved to Liu Yuniang and left the house while she stared at her with her lips pursed.
